Usage: scrcpy [options]

Options:

    --always-on-top
        Make scrcpy window always on top (above other windows).

    --flex-display
        Resize the Android display to fit the window.

    --keep-active
        Keep the screen on by simulating user activity.

    --max-fps=value
        Limit the frame rate of screen capture.

    --new-display[=[<width>x<height>][/<dpi>]]
        Create a new display with the specified resolution and density.

    --no-audio
        Disable audio forwarding.

    --no-vd-system-decorations
        Disable virtual display system decorations flag.

    --serial=serial
        The device serial number.

    --start-app=name
        Start an Android app, by its exact package name.

    --video-codec=name
        Select a video codec (h264, h265 or av1).

    --window-height=value
        Set the initial window height.

    --window-title=text
        Set a custom window title.
